rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for doing something at any time.

example.english: You can call me whenever you need help.

rows.note: Use this when assuring someone that any time is acceptable, especially in an invitation or permission.

example.english: Come over whenever you’re free; any time is fine.

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for saying that any time is acceptable or possible.

example.english: Whenever you want to eat, it's fine.
example.jyutping: gei2 si4 soeng2 sik6 faan6 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this when the result happens every single time the event occurs.

example.english: Whenever it rains heavily, the street floods.
example.traditional: 每次落大雨，條街都水浸。
example.jyutping: mui5 ci3 lok6 daai6 jyu5 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 seoi2 zam3
